expectations.text: Nests credentials inside an auth block (auth = { universal = { client_id, client_secret } })
expectations.evidence: MISSING required /auth\s*=?\s*\{[\s\S]{0,200}universal/ | MISSING required /^ {4,}client_id\s*=/ | OK absent /^ {0,3}client_id\s*=/

expectations.text: Uses `name` as the ephemeral secret's key attribute, not `secret_key`
Uses an ephemeral resource (not a data source) so the value stays out of state
Declares the provider source as infisical/infisical
